The '''Hocatar sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. It contained the [[Hellhoop/Legends|Hellhoop]] and the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Attahox/Legends|Attahox]].
